يتعاهدوا (form VI)
# يَتَعَاهَدُوا (yataʕāhadū) /ja.ta.ʕaː.ha.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَعَاهَدَ (taʕāhada)
# يُتَعَاهَدُوا (yutaʕāhadū) /ju.ta.ʕaː.ha.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَعَاهَدَ (taʕāhada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
